seam_change_definition: Display x index maps to B27 source (x+shift_cells) modulo 240. Relative seam change=1.5 degrees*shift_cells, but no official Orbina longitude is assigned.
seam_score: Count latitude rows where both sides of map boundary are land cells owned by the same B16 polygon. It indicates displayed continental cut severity and does not measure true coast/tectonics.

recommended_noncanonical_display_cut.warning: Only a visual candidate, not a formal prime meridian.

cyclic_connectivity_method: 4-neighbor land or same-owner connected components with and without periodic east-west wrap. All shifts preserve periodic topology, but bounded cut introduces apparent pieces.

polar_silhouette.pole_extreme_row_status: Both top and bottom source-raster rows contain ocean only. Other high-latitude islands/continents require high-resolution coastline review; absence in 240x120 mask does not certify either pole.
polar_silhouette.cap_definition: Counts of rasterized land cell centers at candidate latitude >=75 or <=-75 degrees. Not real land/ice.

interpretation_limits: Shifting central-meridian display changes what is cut at the left/right boundary but never moves actual source land.
99 B16 polygons exist; 91 have at least one hit in coarse raster and the remaining 8 are not deleted.
Area and climate fields from B25/B26 remain conditional, and a screen projection cannot fix physically unlikely coast shape.
The 57-cell shift is an illustration chosen by a one-dimensional seam score, not a verified optimal or official planetary center.
No national location, radius, axial tilt, prime meridian, polar ice or physical scale inferred.
next: B29 should restore tiny B16 islands in a vector-coast overlay and compare high resolution seams before deciding whether any candidate arrangement is suitable for canon.
